name: patient_sex_is_female_now
meaning: Boolean variable indicating whether the patient's current sex is female.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current sex is documented as female.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current sex is documented as male or other.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_has_clinical_diagnosis_of_chronic_pelvic_pain_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of chronic pelvic pain.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of chronic pelvic pain.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a clinical diagnosis of chronic pelvic pain.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a clinical diagnosis of chronic pelvic pain.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_non_menstrual_pelvic_pain_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has non-menstrual pelvic pain.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has non-menstrual pelvic pain.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have non-menstrual pelvic pain.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has non-menstrual pelvic pain.

name: patient_has_finding_of_noncyclic_pelvic_pain_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has noncyclic pelvic pain.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has noncyclic pelvic pain.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have noncyclic pelvic pain.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has noncyclic pelvic pain.

name: pain_duration_value_recorded_in_months
meaning: Numeric value representing the duration of pain experienced by the patient, measured in months.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration of pain in months is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of months the patient has experienced pain, as documented in the patient's record or reported by the patient.

name: patient_has_finding_of_pain_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had pain in their history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had pain at any point in their history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never had pain in their history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had pain in their history.

name: patient_pain_value_recorded_now_withunit_months
meaning: Numeric value representing the duration in months of the patient's current or most recent episode of pain as of now.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration of pain is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined as of now.
when_value: Set to the number of months if the duration of the patient's current or most recent episode of pain is known and recorded now.

name: patient_is_pregnant_inthepast12months
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient was pregnant at any time within the past 12 months.
when_true: Set to true if there is evidence that the patient was pregnant at any time within the past 12 months.
when_false: Set to false if there is evidence that the patient was not pregnant at any time within the past 12 months.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the patient was pregnant within the past 12 months.
